electrical_public_spec.standard_charge_table_discrepancy: Published table says 0.2C (2mA), but 0.2 x 110mAh is 22mA. Do not infer or silently correct it; prototype uses 9-11mA and requires physical qualification.

pack_protection_public_spec.manufacturer_short_test: fully charged pack, 0.1 ohm across contacts for 1 hour; then remove resistor and charge at 1C for 5 seconds
pack_protection_public_spec.manufacturer_short_acceptance: OCV >=3.6V and no rupture, fire, smoke or leakage
pack_protection_public_spec.safety_execution_limit: Manufacturer states safety-characteristic tests are for specialized Li-ion personnel or work under detailed manufacturer instruction. Do not perform a real-pack short during ordinary EVT.
